description: Material class for thermoplastic moulding compounds (resins). Declares the properties a thermoplastic class carries: the polymer and filler designation and the processing window from the supplier datasheet. A recipe band on the injection moulding machine must lie inside the window of its resin's class.

attributes.name: polymer_family
attributes.description: Polymer as designated by ISO 1043-1 (e.g. PA66, PMMA, ASA+PC).

attributes.name: filler_type
attributes.description: Filler or reinforcement as designated by ISO 1043-2 (e.g. GF glass fibre, CF carbon fibre, MD mineral); absent when unfilled.

attributes.name: filler_content
attributes.description: Filler content in mass percent (the 30 in PA66-GF30).

attributes.name: residual_moisture_max
attributes.description: Maximum residual moisture at processing (supplier datasheet).

attributes.name: melt_temp_min
attributes.description: Lower end of the melt temperature window (supplier datasheet).

attributes.name: melt_temp_max
attributes.description: Upper end of the melt temperature window (supplier datasheet).

attributes.name: mould_temp_min
attributes.description: Lower end of the mould temperature window (supplier datasheet).

attributes.name: mould_temp_max
attributes.description: Upper end of the mould temperature window (supplier datasheet).

isa95.note: A domain specialisation of MaterialClass: the typed attributes are MaterialClassProperty entries in B2MML (MaterialClass.MaterialClassProperty, one per attribute). The relationship INCLUDES_PROPERTIES_OF is inherited from SMProfile-MaterialClass.
